snippet.title: Bingo Betty - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming this summer, to a retirement home near you!

Bingo betty is a gambling roguelite straight from the bowels of hell! Play as a destitute senior on their last quest to take it all back from the big man himself! Chain ridiculous effects and combos to create absurd bingo combos! Dominate your friends in online strategic gameplay!

Wishlist now on steam! Available July 31, 2026!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4045170/Bingo_Betty/

Want tips on how to brush up on your bingo skills? Check out the official game guide over at https://playbingobetty.com/guide/
